units.source_text: 藤侍从是个忠实的人，颇为薰君抱屈。

en.t: The Fuji Chamberlain was a loyal man and felt deeply aggrieved on Lord Kaoru's behalf.

units.source_text: 薰君本人对大女公子并不迷恋，但求婚不遂，总觉可惜耳。

en.t: Lord Kaoru himself was not infatuated with the elder young lady, but since his proposal had failed, he could not help feeling it was a pity.

units.source_text: 至于藏人少将，则认真地悲伤，心绪一直不宁，左思右想，几乎做出非礼行为来。

en.t: As for the Lesser Captain of the Bureau of Archivists, he grieved in earnest, remained restless at heart, and after brooding this way and that, nearly did something improper.

units.source_text: 向大女公子求婚的许多人之中，有的已把爱情移向二女公子身上。

en.t: Among the many men who had courted the elder young lady, some had already transferred their affection to the second young lady.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍深恐云居雁对她怀恨，

en.t: Lady Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, was deeply afraid that Kumoi no Kari might resent her,

units.source_text: 拟将二女公子许配藏人少将，曾向他暗示此意。

en.t: and so she meant to marry the second young lady to the Lesser Captain of the Bureau of Archivists, and had once hinted this intention to him.

units.source_text: 但藏人少将从此以后不再上门。

en.t: But after that, the Lesser Captain of the Bureau of Archivists no longer came to visit.

units.source_text: 本来，他常常偕诸兄弟出入冷泉院，非常亲睦。

en.t: Originally, he often went in and out of Reizei-in together with his brothers, and they were on very intimate terms there.

units.source_text: 自从大女公子入院以后，他也就裹足不前了。

en.t: Ever since the elder young lady had entered the院, he too had held back and stopped going there.

units.source_text: 偶尔出现在殿上，便觉索然无味，立刻像逃走一般退出。

en.t: If he occasionally appeared at court, he would at once find everything dull and withdraw as though fleeing.
